newsitem.title: USA: News Communications to name Ross CEO.
newsitem.headline: News Communications to name Ross CEO.

text.p: News Communications Inc said Friday that Wilbur Ross, senior managing director of Rothschild Inc, will be named chief executive officer and chairman of the executive committee at the media company.
Ross, the husband of New York's Lieutenant Gov. Betsy McCaughey Ross, will remain at Rothschild.
Ross and a group of investors are spending $2 million to buy 200,000 shares of a new class of $10 preferred stock, which is convertible into one million shares of common stock.
The investors also will receive warrants to purchase 800,000 shares of common stock, which will be exercisable at $2 per share for a period of five years.
Jerry Finkelstein, chairman of the company's board of directors, will remain as chairman. Michael Schenkler, the company president, will remain in that position.
Ross and the other investors will have the authority to designate and elect half of the board directors.

The board nominees are expected to be co-investors Robert Nederlander, president of the Nederlander Organization; Sy Syms, chief executive of Syms Corp; Mark Dickstein, president of Dickstein Partners Inc; Carl Bernstein, the former Washington Post reporter; Hillel Winberger, senior vice president of investments at Loew's CNA Holdings Inc; and John McConnoughty, retired chairman of Pullman Peabody Co.
News Communications publishes 23 publications in the New York area and in Washington, D.C.
